metadata.dataset_scope: Synthetic BioDevOps arrhythmia scenarios SYN-MAUDE-0001..0005 plus append-only extension scenarios SYN-MAUDE-0006..0007.
metadata.severity_scale: 1=no harm, 2=minor harm/process exposure risk, 3=serious harm or clinically serious exposed event with no recorded harm, 4=life-threatening/death.
metadata.mapping_status: Signed off for the five curated scenarios; no full SNOMED-CT import is performed.

25569003.label: Ventricular tachycardia
25569003.clinical_note: VTach is intrinsically life_threatening because it can degenerate to ventricular fibrillation.

71908006.label: Ventricular fibrillation
71908006.clinical_note: VFib is intrinsically life_threatening because it is a malignant ventricular rhythm associated with loss of effective cardiac output.

27885002.label: Complete atrioventricular block
27885002.clinical_note: Complete AV block with prolonged ventricular pause is treated as life_threatening in this mapping because missed detection can permit syncope, arrest, or death.

49436004.label: Atrial fibrillation
49436004.clinical_note: AFib is serious but not intrinsically life_threatening in this mapping; its danger is indirect, such as stroke or rapid ventricular response.

698247007.label: Cardiac arrhythmia
698247007.clinical_note: Candidate monitored-target code for the outage scenario. In SYN-MAUDE-0005 it is not an observed arrhythmia; the clinical floor comes from process/exposure risk.

SYN-MAUDE-0001.note: Missed sustained VTach occurred in an exposed patient with no adverse patient outcome recorded.

SYN-MAUDE-0002.note: AFib episode was documented and the patient died; the severity floor is driven by documented death, not intrinsic AFib lethality.

SYN-MAUDE-0003.note: False-positive AFib alerts exposed a patient to alert-fatigue process risk; no AFib clinical event occurred.

SYN-MAUDE-0004.note: Pre-release VTach sensitivity regression was blocked before patient exposure.

SYN-MAUDE-0005.note: The code is the monitored target of an outage, not an observed arrhythmia; floor comes from process/exposure risk.

SYN-MAUDE-0006.note: Missed brief self-terminating VFib occurred in an exposed patient with no adverse patient outcome recorded; the malfunction was found retrospectively after the classifier confidence remained just below the configured alarm threshold.

SYN-MAUDE-0007.note: Missed transient complete AV block with prolonged ventricular pause occurred in an exposed patient with no adverse patient outcome recorded; the malfunction was found retrospectively after the pause duration sat just below the configured alarm threshold.
